name: .Wave
long_description:
.Wave builds a continuous inference engine for streaming AI models, including full-duplex voice and streaming speech recognition.   

Customers bring their models; we integrate and run them, managing execution, session state, and scheduling to reduce end-to-end latency and serving cost per live session.  

We use cadenced inference to support more concurrent sessions per GPU while keeping latency low and consistent.
one_liner: Continuous inference for streaming AI models
